turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Inspector Sharma from Cyber Crime Branch. I'm calling about a serious matter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A parcel in your name was intercepted at Mumbai airport containing illegal substances. An FIR has been registered.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect this call. Do not tell anyone, not even your family.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your Aadhaar was used for money laundering. The court order is being processed as we speak.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To clear your name, you must transfer the verification amount to the safe RBI account immediately. Within 30 minutes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't comply, you will be arrested today. This is your last warning.
